job.title: Lead Assembly Operator
job.description:
Now hiring Lead Assembly Operator in Plano, TX for a full-time, 1st shift Monday–Friday schedule, starting at $18.00 - $19.00/hour. This is an on-site role in a manufacturing/production environment where you’ll help assemble, inspect, and test electronic products while following quality and safety standards.


Benefits

  • Competitive weekly pay
  • Medical and dental benefits available
  • Access to free online education programs and financial tools
  • Supportive, associate-first culture


About the Role

As an Assembly Operator, you’ll assemble, inspect, and support production of electronic products (including printed circuit board assemblies and box-build products). You’ll follow work instructions, drawings, and quality standards while maintaining a safe, clean workspace and meeting productivity expectations.


Pay Rate: $18.00 - $19.00/hour


Available Shift Times

  • 1st Shift: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM


Key Responsibilities

  • Assemble PCBA and box-build products using work instructions, drawings, and established processes
  • Perform manual/mechanical assembly tasks (fastening, wiring, labeling, soldering as assigned)
  • Use hand tools, torque drivers, soldering/test equipment, and other production tools safely
  • Inspect assemblies for defects and verify correct installation/component orientation
  • Complete production/inspection records and maintain material/assembly traceability
  • Follow ESD controls (wrist straps/ESD footwear/mats) and maintain 5S/clean work areas
  • Communicate quality issues, material shortages, or equipment concerns to leadership


Key Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Basic computer skills
  • Ability to read and follow technical documents/work instructions (drawings/schematics as needed)
  • Strong attention to detail and quality focus
  • Ability to stand for extended periods in a manufacturing environment
  • Ability to occasionally lift/move up to 50 lbs
  • Commitment to safety practices, including ESD compliance
  • Preferred (not required): 1+ year experience with PCBA/box-build assembly or similar production environment

Integrity Staffing

job.title: Material Handler
job.description:
Now hiring Material Handler in Plano, TX  for a full-time, 1st shift Monday–Friday schedule. Starting pay is $20.00/hr (up to $21.00/hr depending on placement), in a climate-controlled electronics/manufacturing environment supporting production operations and material flow.


Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision options
  • Access to additional benefits and support resources through Integrity Staffing (details provided during onboarding)


About the Role

As a Material Handler, you’ll support production by receiving, moving, staging, and tracking electronic components and materials across production areas (SMT, PCBA, DIP, and Box Build). You’ll help maintain inventory accuracy, prevent shortages, and follow ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) handling standards.


Pay Rate: $20.00–$21.00/hr


Available Shift Times

  • Monday–Friday | 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM


Key Responsibilities

  • Receive, label, move, and distribute raw materials, components, WIP, and finished goods throughout the facility
  • Pick, kit, stage, replenish, and deliver materials to production lines based on schedules/work orders
  • Perform inventory transactions in an ERP/WMS system (receipts, transfers, issues, returns, adjustments)
  • Support cycle counts and assist with physical inventory audits
  • Follow FIFO/FEFO practices where applicable and maintain component traceability (lot/date/serial)
  • Operate pallet jacks/carts/forklifts (when trained/authorized)
  • Follow safety procedures, maintain clean work areas (5S), and comply with ESD requirements and quality standards


Key Requirements

  • 1+ year of material handling, warehouse, inventory control, or manufacturing experience preferred
  • Electronics manufacturing experience (SMT/PCBA/box build) strongly preferred
  • Comfortable standing for long periods; occasional lifting/moving up to 50 lbs
  • Basic computer/data entry skills (ERP/WMS experience a plus)
  • Ability to read part numbers, labels, and work orders accurately
  • Strong attention to detail, reliable attendance, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Must be able to wear required PPE and ESD equipment

job.title: Stand Up forklift
job.description:
Stand-Up Forklift Operator – Shipping Dock



Pay Rate: $18.50 per hour
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM – 6:30 PM
Shift: 1st Shift

Job Overview

Highline Warren is seeking an experienced and dependable Stand-Up Forklift Operator to join its shipping dock team in Elkton, MD. This position is responsible for safely operating stand-up forklifts, moving and organizing products, and supporting daily shipping operations to ensure orders are processed accurately and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Safely operate stand-up forklifts to move, load, unload, and stage materials.

  • Transport finished products and pallets throughout the warehouse and shipping dock.

  • Prepare and stage outgoing shipments according to shipping schedules.

  • Load and unload trailers while ensuring proper product handling.

  • Verify product quantities and inspect shipments for accuracy and damage.

  • Assist with picking, packing, and organizing orders as needed.

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.

  • Follow all warehouse safety procedures and company guidelines.

  • Work closely with shipping and warehouse team members to meet daily productivity goals.

Qualifications

  • Previous stand-up forklift operating experience required.

  • Experience working in a warehouse, distribution center, or shipping dock preferred.

  • Ability to safely maneuver forklifts in busy warehouse environments.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, physically active setting.

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. as needed.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to workplace safety.

  • Reliable attendance and ability to work the assigned schedule.

Position Details

  • Pay: $18.50/hour

  • Hours: 10:00 AM – 6:30 PM

  • Days: Monday through Friday

  • Location: Elkton, Maryland

 

This is a great opportunity for an experienced forklift operator looking for a consistent weekday schedule and a hands-on role with an established automotive products distribution company.

job.title: Seasonal Package Handlers - Multiple Shifts
job.description:

This is a seasonal, direct hire role earning up to $21.00/hour! There is also a $1,000 end of season bonus for all candidates who successfully complete the assignment!

As a Package Handler, you'll be a vital part of our warehouse team—helping ensure packages are unloaded, sorted, and loaded efficiently and safely. You'll work in a supportive environment that emphasizes safety, teamwork, and operational excellence, handling packages with care and precision.

job.title: SMT Operator
job.description:
Now hiring SMT Operator in Plano, TX for a 1st shift schedule (Mon–Fri, 7:00 AM–3:30 PM) at $19.00 - $20.00/hr. This is a full-time, onsite role supporting a fast-paced production environment with a focus on quality, safety, and process consistency.

  • 401(k) options may be available
  • Access to additional Integrity associate programs and resources (education and financial tools)


About the Role

As an SMT Operator, you’ll operate and monitor surface mount technology (SMT) production equipment used to assemble printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs). You’ll help keep production running smoothly by loading materials, supporting setups/changeovers, inspecting output, maintaining records, and following ESD and safety standards.


Pay Rate: $19.00 - $20.00/hr


Available Shift Times

  • Monday–Friday | 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM (First Shift)


Key Responsibilities

  • Operate SMT production equipment following work instructions and safety guidelines
  • Load and verify components/materials (feeders, reels, trays) and confirm part/lot traceability
  • Monitor equipment, respond to alarms/jams, and perform basic troubleshooting within training
  • Support setup/changeover procedures and verify feeder locations and placement vs. documentation
  • Perform first-piece and in-process inspections; identify and segregate defects
  • Maintain ESD controls (wrist straps/ESD footwear/mats, etc.) and follow IPC workmanship expectations
  • Complete production documentation and records; support cleaning and operator-level preventive maintenance
  • Maintain a clean, organized workspace using 5S practices
  • Communicate shortages, quality issues, and delays to leads/supervisors promptly


Key Requirements

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Basic computer skills and ability to read technical documents/work instructions (and schematics as needed)
  • Ability to stand for extended periods; ability to lift/move up to 50 lbs occasionally
  • Strong attention to detail and quality focus; able to work independently and as part of a team
  • Preferred: 1+ year experience in SMT/PCBA manufacturing; familiarity with ESD practices and IPC standards

job.title: Warehouse Associate
job.description:
Our client provides revolutionary products to the entire United States. They are currently looking to bring on a team player to fill an exciting role as a Warehouse Associate in Nanticoke, PA earning up to $21.50 an hour!. 1st, 3rd and W.E shifts available 


Benefits and Perks:

  • This is a temp-to-hire opportunity
  • Climate controlled
  • 1-hour unpaid lunch break
  • Paid Weekly
  • Vending machines and onsite cafe (cold food only) in break room
  • Day 1 Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance


Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Team Members will focus on unloading, counting, and putting product from our vendors into Inventory
  • Team Members will ensure all shipments are unloaded without damaging product, counted correctly to reconcile against Purchase Orders, and accurately stored in inventory to be made available for online purchasing
  • Team Members will ensure all customer orders are picked correctly, packaged with care, and loaded on-time so they arrive to the customer on-time
  • FC Team Members must be capable of operating Powered Industrial Trucks (PIT) in accordance with all aspects of Spreetail's safety and training guidelines
  • All associates in a Spreetail FC will ensure customer orders are accurate and delivered on-time by following the training and job instruction outlined for their respective job function
  • Team Members in the FC will meet or exceed job expectations for Safety, Performance, Reliability, Education, and Effort (SPREE)
  • Flexibility is key. Be open to extra hours and an extra pace; we don't fulfill our customer promise without it.
  • How do you feel about lifting heavy things repeatedly? Awesome! We ship anything from mattresses to sheds and we need muscle!


Required:

  • Positive attitude, team player, and care for safety of yourself and others
  • Ability to work on your feet for 10 to 12 hour shifts
  • Ability to work weekends, holidays, and mandatory OT as scheduled
  • Able to lift up to 70 lbs. by yourself
  • Comfortable learning and operating Powered Industrial Trucks (PIT)
  • Comfortable using technology frequently, such as computers and smart phones


Preferred:

  • Experience working in other fulfillment, distribution, and/or manufacturing warehouses
  • Expertise in Warehouse Management Systems, basic functions of Microsoft Word/Excel
  • Recent experience operating High Reach, Order Pickers, Forklifts, and other PIT


Key Behaviors:

  • Safety - Keeps clean work area & proactively addresses safety concerns
  • Performance - Meets expected performance rates and always stays on-task
  • Reliability - Always on-time to work, ready to work and works well without constant supervision
  • Education - Reaches training benchmarks on-time and follows job instructions
  • Effort - Works with respect and urgency at all times; receives feedback well

job.title: Amazon Robotics Warehouse Associate
job.description:
Amazon Robotics Warehouse Associate

Shifts:
Day, Night, Weekend

Location:
Robbinsville, NJ
(50 New Canton Way, Robbinsville, NJ)
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate:  Up to $25.25

Job Overview

You’ll be part of the Amazon warehouse team that gets orders ready for customers relying on Amazon services. Our fast-paced, physical roles take place in a variety of areas including merch, make-on-demand, customer returns, Prime Now, and general fulfillment. You will be selecting, packing, and shipping orders – in some cases, for our super-fast (2-hour or less) delivery service.

Duties & Responsibilities
Some of your duties may include:
  1. Receive and put away inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready and pack them up
  3. Load boxes into trucks for shipment
  4. Use scanners to read bar codes on products
  5. View prompts on screens and follow the direction for some tasks
  6. Troubleshoot problems
  7. Ensure product meets quality requirements
  8. Operate power industrial trucks (PIT) such as a forklift or pallet driver, and work at heights up to 35 feet. Equipment training and certification are provided free of cost.
You'll also need to be able to:
  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Push utility carts up to 60 pounds
  3. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  4. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  5. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  6. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  7. Adhere to strict safety, quality, and fulfillment production standards
What it's like at an Amazon Fulfillment Center
  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.
Why You’ll Love this Job
  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  5. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn: how to operate a garment press and high-capacity printer, a t-shirt folding machine, how to assist with the print production process, or how to receive and process customer returns.
  6. Free training. Depending on the role and location, we’ll teach you how to drive power industrial trucks (PIT) such as forklifts or a pallet driver, how the printing process works, and how to work with the latest Amazon technology – including robots.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.
Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:
  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program
Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/
Requirements:
  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.
How To Get Started
You can begin by applying above. If you need help with your application or to learn more about our hiring process, you can find support here: https://hiring.amazon.com/hiring-process#/.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation during the application and hiring process, including support for the New Hire Event, or need to initiate a request prior to starting your Day 1, please visit https://hiring.amazon.com/people-with-disabilities#/ or contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You can reach us by phone at 888-435-9287, Monday through Friday, between 6 a.m. and 4 p.m. PT.

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking an experienced, hands-on Production Manager to lead day-to-day manufacturing operations for a precision manufacturing environment. job.title: General Labor / Packing Associate - 1st Shift
job.description:
Now hiring a General Labor / Packing Associate in Alpharetta, GA. This full-time position offers a steady weekday schedule with shifts from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM, paying $20.00 per hour. The role involves inspecting, packing, labeling, and organizing metal products within a team-oriented manufacturing environment.

Benefits

  • Medical benefit options
  • Flexible pay access options
  • Training and career development resources
  • Support from a dedicated staffing team

About the Role

Join our team at Integrity Staffing Solutions as a General Labor / Packing Associate! You will be working in a well-established manufacturing facility that specializes in high-quality aluminum and metal products used in commercial construction and architectural applications. This position is perfect for reliable, hardworking individuals who enjoy hands-on work and take pride in quality and efficiency.

Pay Rate

$20.00/hour

Available Shift Times

  • Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM (First Shift)

Key Responsibilities

  • Inspect finished aluminum and metal products for quality, damage, and defects
  • Carefully wrap, package, and prepare finished products for shipping
  • Label, organize, and stack packaged materials
  • Assist with loading, unloading, and moving materials throughout the production area
  • Sort products based on size, type, and customer orders
  • Verify quantities and packaging accuracy against work orders
  • Use basic hand tools and packaging equipment
  • Support machine operators and production team members
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment
  • Follow safety guidelines and quality control procedures
  • Work collaboratively to meet daily production and shipping goals

Key Requirements

  • Previous warehouse, manufacturing, packing, or general labor experience preferred but not required
  • Ability to follow instructions and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail when inspecting and packaging products
  • Comfortable handling aluminum and metal materials
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Willingness to learn new tasks and assist in different production areas
  • Basic ability to read labels, work orders, and measurements
  • Ability to stand, reach, bend, lift, and perform repetitive tasks throughout the shift
  • Comfort working in active manufacturing and warehouse environments
  • Willing to handle long or irregularly shaped materials with appropriate assistance or equipment
  • Ability to wear PPE and follow safety procedures

job.title: Fabrication Technician I - 2nd Shift
job.description:
Now hiring Fabrication Technician I in Phoenix, AZ! This full-time, temp-to-hire position offers a competitive pay rate of $19.00 per hour, working the 2nd shift from 2:15 PM to 10:45 PM. Join a team dedicated to creating innovative medical devices that improve mobility and quality of life. No medical device experience necessary—training may be provided! As a Fabrication Technician I, you will fabricate, modify, and repair custom medical devices, using hand tools, power tools, and machinery safely and effectively. Your role will involve measuring, shaping, and assembling components, inspecting finished products, troubleshooting fabrication issues, and maintaining a clean and safe workspace. Working closely with team members, you'll contribute to production goals and ensure high-quality outputs.


Pay Rate: $19.00 per hour


Available Shift Times:
2nd Shift, 2:15 PM–10:45 PM

  • Fabricate, modify, and repair medical devices according to specifications
  • Safely operate hand tools, power tools, and machinery
  • Measure, shape, assemble, and finish components
  • Inspect completed products for quality and durability
  • Troubleshoot fabrication issues to maintain quality standards
  • Assist with inventory management and material organization
  • Follow safety procedures and maintain a clean work environment
  • Learn and adopt new fabrication techniques and technologies
  • Collaborate effectively with team members to meet production targets


Key Requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality
  • Mechanical aptitude and interest in hands-on technical work
  • Ability to safely operate tools and equipment after training
  • Good problem-solving skills and willingness to learn
  • Ability to follow both written and verbal instructions
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Dedication to maintaining a safe and organized workspace


Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent experience

job.title: Amazon Warehouse Equipment Operator
job.description:
Amazon Warehouse Equipment Operator

Shifts:
Day, Overnight, Weekend

Location:
North East, MD
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $23
 
Job Overview
You'll be part of the Amazon warehouse team as an equipment operator - operating order pickers, reach trucks, forklifts, and other powered industrial trucks (PIT) to handle customer orders safely and efficiently. You'll use PIT equipment to unload and load trailers, store pallets, and retrieve pallets throughout the warehouse. No prior experience required—Amazon provides all PIT training and certification for free.

Duties & Responsibilities
Some of your duties may include:
  1. Receive and put away inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready and pack them up
  3. Load boxes into trucks for shipment
  4. Use scanners to read bar codes on products
  5. View prompts on screens and follow the direction for some tasks
  6. Troubleshoot problems
  7. Ensure product meets quality requirements
  8. Operate power industrial trucks (PIT) such as a forklift or pallet driver, and work at heights up to 35 feet. Equipment training and certification are provided free of cost.
You'll also need to be able to:
  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Push utility carts up to 60 pounds
  3. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  4. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  5. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  6. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  7. Adhere to strict safety, quality, and fulfillment production standards
What it's like at an Amazon Fulfillment Center
  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.
Why You’ll Love this Job
  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Full-time (40 hours) with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  5. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn: how to operate a garment press and high-capacity printer, a t-shirt folding machine, how to assist with the print production process, or how to receive and process customer returns.
  6. Free training. Depending on the role and location, we’ll teach you how to drive power industrial trucks (PIT) such as forklifts or a pallet driver, how the printing process works, and how to work with the latest Amazon technology – including robots.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.
Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:
  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program
Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/

Requirements:
  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.
If you have a disability and need an accommodation during the application and hiring process, including support for the New Hire Event, or need to initiate a request prior to starting your Day 1, please visit https://hiring.amazon.com/people-with-disabilities#/ or contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You can reach us by phone at 888-435-9287, Monday through Friday, between 6 a.m. and 4 p.m. PT.

job.title: HR Coordinator
job.description:
HR Coordinator – Temporary Role (no end date known)

Pay rate: $22-25.00/hr.

Shift: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm OT as needed based on business need

As our new HR Coordinator, you will focus on employee relations, investigations, taking statements, documentation, and communication with remote HR leadership, while also providing day-to-day support for onsite operations.

Based full-time at the customer warehouse, you will serve as a primary point of contact for associates and client managers, balancing HR responsibilities with operational coordination to maintain a positive associate and client experience.

This is not a remote position.
Shift: Mon-Fri 9am-5:30pm with OT as needed

Pay Rate: $22-25 per hour

What You’ll Do

  • Act as the onsite HR liaison, representing Integrity Staffing and serving as the link between associates, client managers, and the remote HR leader.
  • Conduct and support employee relations investigations, including interviewing associates, taking statements, documenting incidents, and escalating findings to the remote HR leader for review.
  • Handle confidential associate concerns related to conduct, performance, policy compliance, and workplace interactions.
  • Support onboarding and orientation activities, ensuring associates understand workplace expectations, attendance policies, and escalation procedures.
  • Monitor attendance, validate absences, and maintain documentation for HR-related case tracking.
  • Assist with corrective action processes by preparing documentation, scheduling follow-ups, and ensuring consistency in handling cases.
  • Communicate regularly with the remote HR leader on escalated matters, sharing detailed documentation and recommendations.

What You’ll Need

  • 2–3 years of HR, employee relations, or operations coordination experience; warehouse or staffing environment preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with investigations, interviewing, and incident documentation.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple sensitive issues simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook and Office Suite; ability to adapt to client-specific HR/operations systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to confidently interact with associates, client managers, and HR leadership.
  • High level of discretion, confidentiality, and sound judgment in handling sensitive HR matters.
  • Flexibility to work in a fast-paced environment with both desk-based and floor-based responsibilities.

Physical Demands
This role is based on the floor in the warehouse and requires regular walking and standing, climbing steps, and occasional lifting (up to 49 lbs.) or movement of materials.

job.title: Asociado de Limpieza de Hotel / Mantenimiento
job.description:
Ahora estamos contratando un Asociado de Limpieza de Hotel / Mantenimiento en Atlanta, GA. Este puesto ofrece variedad de turnos y paga $16.00 por hora más horas extra, con ingresos de 900 a 1000 dólares o más por semana! La tarifa de pago aumentará una vez que se formalice la contratación. El puesto se enfoca en crear espacios limpios y listos para recibir a los huéspedes, y se prefiere experiencia previa en limpieza de hoteles. Se anima a postularse a candidatos responsables, detallistas y que se enorgullezcan de realizar un trabajo de calidad.


Beneficios

  • Pago competitivo de $16.00 por hora /$900-$1000+ por semana. La tarifa de pago aumentará una vez que se formalice la contratación.

  • Opciones de turnos consistentes y oportunidades de horas extras

  • Ambiente de trabajo de apoyo


Acerca del Puesto
Como Asociado de Limpieza de Hotel / Mantenimiento, su responsabilidad principal será mantener los estándares de limpieza en las habitaciones de los huéspedes y las áreas comunes. Usted desempeñará un papel fundamental en la creación de un ambiente acogedor e higiénico para los huéspedes, realizando tareas como tender camas, desinfectar baños, quitar el polvo de las superficies y reponer suministros. También ayudará con la limpieza de pasillos, salones de reuniones y otras áreas según sea necesario, siguiendo los procedimientos establecidos de seguridad y saneamiento.


Pago: $16.00 por hora


Horarios de Turnos Disponibles
Varios turnos disponibles, incluyendo opciones durante el día y la tarde/noche, con posibilidad de horas extras según la ocupación del hotel.


Responsabilidades Principales

  • Limpiar y preparar las habitaciones de los huéspedes de acuerdo con los estándares de calidad

  • Tender camas, cambiar la ropa de cama y organizar las habitaciones

  • Desinfectar baños y superficies de alto contacto

  • Quitar el polvo, aspirar, barrer y trapear los pisos

  • Retirar la basura y reponer los suministros

  • Inspeccionar las habitaciones terminadas para asegurarse de que estén listas para recibir a los huéspedes

  • Reportar problemas de mantenimiento o daños

  • Ayudar con la limpieza de áreas comunes y pasillos según sea necesario


Requisitos Principales

  • Se prefiere ampliamente experiencia previa en limpieza de hoteles o limpieza profesional

  • Gran atención a los detalles y orgullo por la calidad del trabajo realizado

  • Capacidad para trabajar eficientemente en un ambiente de ritmo rápido

  • Asistencia confiable y puntualidad

  • Capacidad para realizar tareas físicas, incluyendo estar de pie, caminar, agacharse y levantar objetos

  • Flexibilidad de horario según las necesidades del hotel


¡Encuentra tu próxima oportunidad con Integrity! Si estás listo para unirte a nuestro equipo, ¡POSTÚLATE AHORA y comienza a trabajar rápidamente!


Acerca de Integrity Staffing

Las oportunidades lo son todo. En Integrity, nos apasiona conectar a excelentes talentos con grandes empresas en toda Norteamérica. Adoptamos un enfoque que pone a nuestros asociados en primer lugar porque, cuando nuestros asociados tienen éxito, nuestros clientes también tienen éxito. Ya sea que estés buscando desarrollar tu carrera o necesites un trabajo de medio tiempo, contamos con miles de oportunidades disponibles en importantes empresas de todo el país. También ofrecemos beneficios que apoyan tu bienestar, incluyendo cobertura de salud, programas educativos y herramientas financieras.

Si estás listo para tu próximo desafío, nosotros estamos listos para ser tu Motor de Oportunidades. Trabajemos juntos.

Integrity Staffing Solutions es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades.

Utilizamos inteligencia artificial y herramientas automatizadas de toma de decisiones para ayudar con la evaluación y selección de candidatos, así como para identificar puestos compatibles. job.title: Flexible Staffing Assistant (RPO)
job.description:
Staffing Assistant (On Demand, Temporary) 
 

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking a customer service-oriented individual to work in our offices and staff hiring events. In this role, you will support the hiring process by completing pre-hire paperwork and screening activities while providing customer service to the candidates visiting the office. This is a great entry-level position in a fast-paced environment that will give you insight and experience into the staffing world.

Pay Rate: $15.00 ( $16 seasonal pay rate 9/14/2026 to 12/19/2026) returning to $15.00/hr  12/20/2026

Job Type:This is a temporary  On Demand role. The schedule will vary and is determined based on business need and when hiring events are scheduled. Availability of hours will vary week-to-week.  

  • On Demand hours vary depending on the week and time of year  

The ideal candidate should have the ability to travel to support other locations as needed; Chester and occasionally Petersburg.

Bilingual is a PLUS! 

 

Requirements:  

  • Comfortable utilizing online software, cameras, scanners, and mobile devices. 

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and the ability to learn other platforms. 

  • Comfortable working across multiple screens and computer systems simultaneously. 

  • Ability to remain calm under pressure, handle challenging situations, and multitask in a high-volume, ever-changing environment. 

  • Ability to professionally communicate, prioritizing tact and confidentiality with candidates, staff, and clients, and willingness to present to large groups. 

  • Flexibility to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet business demands. 

  • Preferred customer service experience in retail, recruiting, hospitality industry, or other fast-paced, customer-oriented environments. 

  • Must uphold a high level of integrity in handling confidential information and adhere to standard work instructions for all processes. 

  • High school diploma or GED is required. 

  • In-person attendance and the ability to work overtime as necessary are mandatory. This role cannot be performed remotely. 

 

Job Description:  

  • Guide candidates through pre-hire onboarding activities, ensuring a smooth understanding of the hiring process. Deliver exceptional customer service to all applicants, fostering a sense of welcome and value throughout hiring events and community outreach activities. 

  • Assist candidates to guarantee an accurate and seamless onboarding process, verifying the completion of all application and pre-hire tasks promptly and accurately through the Applicant Tracking System and other technologies. 

  • Ensure all client hiring procedures are fully executed and compliant with client guidelines, encompassing data entry, application review, validation of work authorization documentation, badge photo capture, drug screening administration, and other assigned duties. 

  • Utilize effective communication to ensure applicants understand job details and have all questions and obstacles addressed and resolved prior to departing the recruiting office. 

  • Meet critical deadlines for completing pre-hire activities within client systems, maintaining meticulous attention to detail in a high-volume and fast-paced environment. 

  • Communicate effectively across various channels including in-person interactions, phone calls, emails, live chats, etc., with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction and respect. 

 

Next Steps 

Apply today using the application link in this posting, and we will reach out so we can learn a little bit more about you.

job.title: CNC Machine Operator - 2nd Shift
job.description:
Now hiring: CNC Machine Operator – 2nd Shift in Suwanee, GA. This full-time role offers a pay rate of $22.00 per hour with shift hours from 3:00 PM to 1:30 AM, Monday through Thursday. Join a precision manufacturing team and work with CNC mills, lathes, and machining centers, producing close-tolerance metal components. This is an excellent opportunity for experienced candidates with a mechanical aptitude and knowledge of blueprints, tools, and measurement instruments.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay rate
  • Full-time employment
  • Opportunity to grow your skills in a precision manufacturing environment
  • Supportive team and safety-focused culture

About the Role

As a CNC Machine Operator, you will operate CNC machinery to manufacture high-quality metal parts. You will load and unload workpieces, interpret blueprints, perform inspections, and make adjustments to ensure product specifications are met. Maintaining equipment and adhering to safety standards are essential components of this role.

Pay Rate

$22.00 per hour

Available Shift Times

Monday–Thursday, 3:00 PM–1:30 AM

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate CNC mills, lathes, and machining centers
  • Load/unload workpieces, ensuring proper positioning
  • Follow CNC programs, setup instructions, and process sheets
  • Read and interpret blueprints and specifications
  • Conduct in-process dimensional inspections using precision tools
  • Make offsets or adjustments within established procedures
  • Monitor tool wear and escalate issues
  • Complete accurate production and quality documentation
  • Maintain a clean and safe work environment
  • Meet safety, quality, productivity, and scrap targets

Key Requirements

  • Previous CNC machine operation experience
  • Ability to read blueprints and use precision measurement tools
  • Basic understanding of CNC tooling and machine operation
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills
  • Dependability and ability to work the full second-shift schedule
  • (Preferred) CNC setup/changeover experience and experience in manufacturing gears, drivetrain, automotive, or heavy equipment components

job.title: Warehouse Shift Lead
job.description:
Our Shift Leads are energetic, decisive, and engaging while managing multiple priorities in a changing warehouse environment.

Shift Leads are responsible for all day-to-day operations taking place on their scheduled shift for our temporary workforce at our client location. 
 

Benefits & Perks:

  • Weekly paychecks
  • Opportunity to earn OT
  • Benefits from day one - Medical, dental and vision, including Telemedicine!
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program
  •  

Location: Moreland, GA

Shift; Mon-Fri 6:30pm-3am Pay Rate: $26/hr.  
Shift: Wed-Sat 6:30am-5pm Pay Rate: $25/hr.

Essential Functions
An individual must be able to successfully perform the essential functions of this position with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Coordinate and manage large group meetings for hourly associates, including first-day Welcome Meeting.
  • Provide performance feedback and disciplinary action, including terminations, for hourly associates.
  • Communicate and audit adherence to safety and employee relations policies, investigate complaints or deviations from policy, and make recommendations for corrective action as needed.
  • Maintain appropriate levels of confidentiality, while managing workflow for company and onsite client projects.
  • Build Relationships with Client managers through daily interaction and weekly meetings. Solicit their input of hourly associate performance and department concerns. Provide them with the guidance and support needed to ensure your partnership is contributing to their success.
  • Maintain open door policy with hourly associates, answering questions regarding policies and procedures, actively listening of concerns and issues raised, escalating issues as appropriate, and maintaining confidential conversations.
 

Preferred Minimum Requirements

  • HS Diploma or GED
  • Bilingual in Spanish/English required
  • 3+ years supervisory experience in a warehouse environment, large group experience a plus
  • Experience in client relations, preferably in warehouse or staffing environment
  • Superior customer service, organization and time management skills
  • Advanced level Microsoft Excel and Web-based Applications/Systems
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to operate and problem solve in a fast paced, and fluid environment
  • Ability to adjust schedule for work overtime and be present during changing business needs
  • Desire to learn and develop beyond current role
  • Ability to work onsite at Client location and adjust schedule based on business needs.
 

Physical Requirements:

  • Lift up to 49 pounds
  • Push utility cards up to 60 pounds
  • Use carts, dollies, hand trucks and other gear to move items around
  • Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  • Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  • Stand or walk your entire shift

job.title: Micro Soldering Technician II
job.description:
Now hiring a Micro Soldering Technician II in Duluth, GA. This on-site, bench-based role offers a Pay Rate of $22–$24/hour with shift flexibility. The position focuses on diagnosing and repairing high-value electronic components at the board level, ideal for experienced micro soldering professionals with strong electronics knowledge and precision skills. MUST HAVE MICRO SOLDERING EXPERIENCE


Benefits

  • Opportunity to work on sophisticated electronic equipment
  • Develop advanced micro soldering skills
  • Join a company committed to associate success and career growth


About the Role
As a Micro Soldering Technician II, you will troubleshoot and repair densely populated PCBs, perform precision component replacements, and verify functionality through testing. You will document repair processes and maintain an organized, ESD-safe work environment.


Pay Rate: $22.00/hour


Available Shift Times
Standard business hours, with potential shift flexibility based on project needs


Key Responsibilities

  • Diagnose PCBs and electronic components using schematics, multimeters, microscopes, and other tools
  • Perform precision repairs including LED replacements and reflows
  • Inspect and test repaired boards to ensure quality and functionality
  • Document repair processes accurately and maintain safety standards


Key Requirements

  • Proven micro soldering and PCB repair experience
  • Strong understanding of electronics fundamentals and schematic interpretation
  • Ability to work under a microscope with high attention to detail
  • Familiarity with ESD safety practices
  • Dependability and comfort performing highly detailed technical work

job.title: Forklift Operators
job.description:
Now hiring Forklift Operators in Aurora, with various shift options offering pay rates of up to $23.25 per hour. Whether you're looking for a evening shift or a daytime schedule, this opportunity is perfect for those seeking stable work in a fast-paced logistics environment. No experience required - training will be provided. 


WALK-IN HIRING EVENT!
Date: Monday, October 26th through Saturday, October 31st
Time: Mon-Fri 9:00am-4:00pm | Sat 8:00am-1:00pm
Event Address: 400 Smoke Tree Plaza, Ste 100, North Aurora, IL 60542

Benefits

  • Opportunity to develop essential warehouse and material handling skills
  • Stable and consistent schedule
  • Work in a dynamic team-focused environment


About the Role
As a Warehouse Associate, you'll be manually loading and unloading freight, sorting, stacking, and securing items onto pallets, assisting with basic assembly tasks, and moving inventory throughout the facility using manual or electric pallet jacks. You’ll also be responsible for maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment.


Pay Rate: Up to $23.25/hour


Available Shift Times:

  • Sunday to Thursday, 6:30 AM – 3:00 PM
  • Tuesday to Saturday, 6:30 AM – 3:00 PM
  • Sunday to Thursday, 4:00 PM – 12:30 AM
  • Tuesday to Saturday, 4:00 PM – 12:30 AM


Key Responsibilities

  • Operate a forklift, electric pallet jack, pacer or other machinery used for transporting or shipping goods.
  • Load, unload, pack, and unpack stock of product or pallets from incoming vehicles.
  • Transport, retrieve and/or relocate stock of product or pallets to workstations or other assigned locations within the warehouse.
  • Label and sort incoming and outgoing shipments.
  • Monitor and maintain inventory of incoming and outgoing items.
  • Inspecting equipment before and after use to ensure it's in good working order.
  • Identifying damages and reporting shortages or quality deficiencies.
  • Cleaning equipment after use and disposing of any collected scraps or waste.
  • Carefully handle and dispose of hazardous waste materials whenever necessary.
  • Adhere to health and safety regulations and company policies.
  • This role includes responsibility for ensuring products are handled, stored, and distributed in a manner that maintains their safety, quality, and legality. Team members are expected to follow all standard operating procedures, report any concerns related to product condition or integrity, support traceability through accurate record-keeping, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and product safety awareness.
  • Other duties/responsibilities as necessary.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in operating forklifts, stand-up/reach, order/cherry/stock picker, pallet riders (walkie/EPJ) preferred. 
  • Experience working in a warehouse environment
  • Ability to lift and move up to 75 lbs. regularly
  • Dependable transportation
  • Ability to work full-time with a flexible schedule
  • Provide own clothing (jeans, collared shirt, closed-toed shoes)
  • Enjoy working in a team and following instructions

job.title: Warehouse Yard Jockey
job.description:
Job Summary

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking a safety-focused and dependable Yard Jockey to support daily warehouse and transportation operations within a private, self-contained facility yard. The Yard Jockey is responsible for the safe and efficient movement of trailers, yard equipment, and company assets between dock doors, staging areas, and assigned yard locations.

Pay and Shift: 
$26 per hour
Sun-Wed - 11am-9:30pm
Wed-Sat - 11am-9:30pm

This position operates exclusively on private facility property. There is no public roadway, highway, over-the-road, or overnight driving required.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Yard & Trailer Operations

  • Safely move trailers and company equipment throughout the facility yard as directed by Operations, Transportation, and Warehouse leadership

  • Spot trailers accurately at dock doors, staging areas, and designated yard locations

  • Pull trailers from dock doors only after confirming all required safety and release procedures have been completed

  • Stage trailers to dock doors in alignment with operational needs and dock assignments

  • Maintain constant awareness of yard traffic, pedestrians, dock activity, and equipment movement

  • Operate yard truck/yard goat/hostler/yard tractor in accordance with company safety standards

  • Follow all trailer docking and releasing procedures, including required Trailer Dock Release coordination

  • Maintain safe speeds, use horn signals as required, and stop for pedestrians or unsafe yard conditions

Equipment Inspections & Safety

  • Complete pre-shift inspections of the yard truck prior to beginning trailer moves

  • Inspect key equipment components (brakes, steering, tires, lights, mirrors, horn, backup alarm, fifth wheel, air lines, electrical connections, and fuel/charge level)

  • Perform visual trailer inspections before coupling (landing gear, tires, rear doors, trailer frame, undercarriage, and visible damage)

  • Confirm trailers are safe to move before coupling or relocating

  • Perform proper coupling/uncoupling procedures (fifth wheel lock confirmation, air line + electrical connection, landing gear operation, tug test)

  • Report unsafe equipment, trailer damage, defects, near-misses, incidents, or yard hazards immediately

  • Remove unsafe equipment from operation when required and notify the appropriate supervisor/manager

Communication & Coordination

  • Communicate clearly with Dock Clerks, Dock Supervisors, Transportation, Warehouse, and Operations teams

  • Confirm trailer number, origin, and destination prior to each move

  • Notify the appropriate team member when each move is complete

  • Escalate blocked doors, damaged trailers, unclear instructions, equipment issues, or safety concerns before proceeding

  • Use a two-way radio throughout the shift and maintain professional radio communication

  • Serve as a key liaison between Transportation and Warehouse teams to support trailer flow, dock availability, and operational priorities

Compliance & Yard Safety

  • Follow all company yard safety policies, OSHA-aligned safety practices, and site-specific procedures

  • Wear required PPE (high-visibility safety vest and safety-toe footwear)

  • Carry and monitor an active, charged radio while working in the yard

  • Yield to pedestrians at all times and maintain safe separation from people, vehicles, trailers, dock doors, and fixed structures

  • Use a ground guide when required or when visibility is obstructed

  • Stop work and notify management immediately in the event of an incident, near-miss, collision, equipment damage, or unsafe condition

What You’ll Need (Required Qualifications)

  • Valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL A)

  • Active/current DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate (Medical Card)

  • Prior experience operating commercial vehicles, yard trucks, yard goats, hostlers, or similar equipment

  • Ability to safely couple, move, spot, and uncouple trailers in a yard/warehouse environment

  • Ability to complete required Trailer Docking and Releasing Safety Program upon hire

  • Forklift certification or ability to obtain certification on Pacer and Electric Pallet Jack equipment (including single/double pallet jack operation)

  • Strong understanding of yard safety, trailer movement, backing procedures, dock operations, and equipment inspections

  • Ability to communicate clearly over radio and follow verbal instructions accurately

  • Must be dependable, safety-conscious, detail-oriented, and able to work in a fast-paced logistics environment

Nice to Have (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Previous yard jockey/hostler/spotter/CDL driver experience, dock operations, warehouse, logistics, transportation, or trailer spotting experience

  • Completion of an accredited CDL truck driving program

  • Vocational training/coursework in logistics, transportation, heavy equipment operations, supply chain, or related field

  • Experience in fulfillment, distribution, transportation, or warehouse operations

  • Familiarity with trailer docking, trailer release procedures, dock safety, and yard management practices

Physical & Work Environment

  • Ability to work in an active outdoor yard and warehouse environment

  • Ability to climb in/out of yard trucks and trailers as needed

  • Ability to walk the yard, inspect equipment, connect/disconnect air lines and electrical cords, and operate landing gear

  • Ability to work in varying weather and lighting conditions (rain, heat, cold, low-light operations)

  • Ability to wear required PPE for the duration of the shift

  • Ability to remain alert and focused while operating equipment around pedestrians, dock doors, trailers, and moving vehicles

Why Work With Integrity Staffing Solutions

At Integrity Staffing Solutions, we put people first. We help associates find the right opportunity, succeed on the job, and grow their careers—backed by a team that supports you every step of the way.

Benefits

Eligible associates may have access to benefits such as:

  • Medical, dental, and vision options

  • Paid time off and holiday pay (where applicable)

  • Career advancement and training opportunities

  • Referral programs (where available)

(If you have a standard “day-one benefits” paragraph you prefer, paste it and I’ll swap it in.)

Pre-Employment / Work Authorization (Standard Evergreen Language)

  • Candidates must be able to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

  • This role may require successful completion of worksite-specific screening, which can include background check and/or drug screening based on client or site requirements.

AI-Assisted Hiring Notice (Requested)

Integrity Staffing Solutions may use AI-assisted tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as helping review application information, evaluating job-related skills, and improving recruiting efficiency. These tools are used to support—not replace—human decision-making. All final hiring decisions are made by our recruiting and hiring teams.

job.title: Maintenance Team Lead Technician 2nd Shift
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Maintenance Team Lead to join our Reliability Department. This key role is responsible for leading a team of maintenance technicians and ensuring our production equipment and facilities operate safely and efficiently.

Ready to lead and make a real impact? Apply today to join a team where your skills and leadership will be valued!

Pay: $36 – $38 per hour
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM

Snapshot of a Day-in-the-Life:

  • Lead, direct, and support maintenance team members during the afternoon shift.

What You’ll Bring:

  • High school diploma (or equivalent) required, associate’s degree from a technical school preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of mechanical experience in a manufacturing setting; 5+ years preferred.
  • Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage team dynamics effectively.
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems, including pneumatics, hydraulics, PLCs, VFDs, and control safety circuits.
  • Experience with welding, machining, fabrication, HVAC, boilers, and ammonia systems is a plus.
  • Familiarity with OSHA safety standards and arc flash regulations.
  • Proficient in troubleshooting and problem-solving.
  • Comfortable lifting up to 50 lbs. and working independently or within a team.
  • Experience with SAP or similar CMMS software is advantageous.

job.title: Call center
job.description:
Collections Representative

Location: Newark, Delaware | 100% On-Site
Pay: $18.00 per hour
Schedule: Full-Time, Flexible Day/Evening Availability Required
Training: Paid, Monday-Friday, 8:30 AM-4:30 PM

Position Overview

Integrity Staffing Solutions is seeking Collections Representatives for an established financial services and accounts receivable organization in Newark, Delaware.

This is an excellent opportunity for customer service professionals interested in transitioning into the collections industry. Previous collections experience is preferred but not required. Comprehensive training is provided to help you develop the skills needed to succeed.

As a Collections Representative, you will communicate with consumers by phone, provide professional customer service, discuss account and payment matters, and work toward appropriate resolutions. Successful candidates will be comfortable having financial conversations while remaining professional, respectful, and attentive to established procedures.

What You'll Do

  • Communicate professionally with consumers regarding their accounts.

  • Provide a positive customer experience while handling potentially sensitive financial conversations.

  • Work with consumers to understand their circumstances and identify appropriate account resolutions.

  • Accurately document conversations, account information, and outcomes.

  • Follow established policies, procedures, scripts, and compliance requirements.

  • Handle inbound and outbound telephone communication professionally.

  • Meet established performance, quality, attendance, and productivity expectations.

  • Participate fully in training and ongoing coaching.

  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling consumer information.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Previous customer service experience.

  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.

  • Professional and respectful telephone presence.

  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused during challenging conversations.

  • Comfortable discussing account and payment-related matters.

  • Basic computer skills and ability to learn new systems.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures.

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.

  • Ability to work 100% on-site in Newark, DE.

  • Ability to meet all scheduling requirements.

Preferred:

  • Previous collections or accounts receivable experience.

  • Previous call center or high-volume customer contact experience.

Collections experience is a plus, but it is not required. Candidates with a strong customer service background who are interested in making a career change are encouraged to apply.

Schedule Requirements

Candidates must be available for all required scheduling needs, including:

  • Day shift: 8:00 AM-5:00 PM

  • Evening shift: 12:00 PM-9:00 PM, at least two evenings per week

  • Saturdays: Up to every other Saturday, 8:00 AM-12:00 PM

This is an in-office position with no remote option.

Mandatory Training

The next training class begins September 2.

Training is mandatory:

Monday-Friday | 8:30 AM-4:30 PM

Each training day includes a one-hour lunch and two paid 15-minute breaks. Candidates must be able to attend the complete training schedule.

Workplace Expectations

  • Dress Code: Business Casual

  • Maintain a professional approach when interacting with consumers and team members.

  • Be dependable and prepared to work assigned schedules.

  • Successfully complete required training and ongoing development.

Interview Process

Qualified candidates will participate in a structured interview process. Candidates selected to interview should be prepared to:

  • Review the complete job description and scheduling requirements before interviewing.

  • Confirm reliable transportation to the Newark office for all scheduled shifts.

  • Discuss their customer service experience and interest in collections.

  • Identify Integrity Staffing Solutions as the staffing agency that referred them.

Candidates with direct collections experience may receive priority interview consideration.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

If you have customer service experience and are looking for an opportunity to develop a new skill set, this position provides a pathway into the collections and financial services industry. You'll receive the training necessary to learn the role while building valuable experience in customer communication, account resolution, and financial services.

Ready to take the next step? Apply today with Integrity Staffing Solutions to be considered for an upcoming Collections Representative training class.

job.title: Amazon Sortation Center Warehouse Associate
job.description:
Amazon Sortation Center Warehouse Associate

Location:
Plainfield, IN
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $22.75
 
Job Overview
You’ll be part of the dedicated Amazon team that is the first stop on the journey from the warehouse. Our fast-paced, physical roles take place in a sortation center. You will be sorting, scanning, and stacking packages on pallets, helping to get customer orders ready for delivery. Because most of the shifts are part-time, you are in control of your schedule choosing shifts that work best for you now and the ability to adjust your schedule in the future, as needed.

Duties & Responsibilities
Some of your duties may include:
  1. Receive and sort inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready for delivery
  3. Use technology like scanners, computers, and handheld printers
You'll also need to be able to:
  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  3. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  4. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  5. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)

What it’s like at an Amazon Sortation Center
  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.

Why You'll Love this Job
  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Anytime Pay. You can instantly cash out up to 70% of your earnings immediately after your shift (for select employee groups). Learn more about Anytime Pay..
  5. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  6. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn how to use the latest Amazon technology – including handheld devices and robotics.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.

Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:
  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program
 
Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/

Requirements:
  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirement and safety guidelines

How To Get Started
You can begin by applying above. If you need help with your application or to learn more about our hiring process, you can find support here: https://hiring.amazon.com/hiring-process#/.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation during the application and hiring process, including support for the New Hire Event, or need to initiate a request prior to starting your Day 1, please visit https://hiring.amazon.com/people-with-disabilities#/ or contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You can reach us by phone at 888-435-9287, Monday through Friday, between 6 a.m. and 4 p.m. PT.

job.title: Amazon Warehouse Equipment Operator
job.description:
Amazon Warehouse Equipment Operator

Location:
Plainfield, IN
Job opportunities vary by location. We update postings daily with open positions.

Hourly pay rate: Up to $22.75/hr

Job OverviewYou'll be part of the Amazon warehouse team as an equipment operator - operating order pickers, reach trucks, forklifts, and other powered industrial trucks (PIT) to handle customer orders safely and efficiently. You'll use PIT equipment to unload and load trailers, store pallets, and retrieve pallets throughout the warehouse. No prior experience required—Amazon provides all PIT training and certification for free.

Duties & Responsibilities
Some of your duties may include:
  1. Receive and put away inventory
  2. Get customer orders ready and pack them up
  3. Load boxes into trucks for shipment
  4. Use scanners to read bar codes on products
  5. View prompts on screens and follow the direction for some tasks
  6. Troubleshoot problems
  7. Ensure product meets quality requirements
  8. Operate power industrial trucks (PIT) such as a forklift or pallet driver, and work at heights up to 35 feet. Equipment training and certification are provided free of cost.
You'll also need to be able to:
  1. Lift up to 49 pounds
  2. Push utility carts up to 60 pounds
  3. Stand, walk, push, pull, squat, bend, and reach during shifts
  4. Use carts, dollies, hand trucks, and other gear to move items around
  5. Go up and down stairs (where applicable)
  6. Work at a height of up to 40 feet on a mezzanine (where applicable)
  7. Adhere to strict safety, quality, and fulfillment production standards

What it's like at an Amazon Fulfillment Center
  1. Safety. Your safety is important to us, so we provide protective gear. All teams share safety tips daily.
  2. Surroundings. You’ll be working around moving machines – order pickers, stand-up forklifts, turret trucks, and mobile carts.
  3. Activity. Some activities may require standing in one place for long periods, walking around, or climbing stairs.
  4. Temperature. Even with climate controls, temperatures can vary between 60°F and 90°F in some parts of the warehouse; on hot days, temperatures can be over 90°F in the truck yard or inside trailers.
  5. Noise level. It can get noisy at times. We provide hearing protection if you need it.
  6. Dress code. Relaxed, with a few rules to follow for safety. Comfortable, closed-toe shoes are required. Depending on the role or location, Amazon provides a $110 Zappos gift code towards the purchase of shoes, in order to have you prepared for your first day on the job.

Why You’ll Love this Job
  1. Stay busy. You and your team are engaged the entire shift.
  2. Schedule options. Depending on where you work, schedules may include full-time (40 hours), reduced-time (30-36 hours) or part-time (20 hours or less), all with the option of working additional hours if needed.
  3. Shift flexibility. Work when it works for you. Shifts may include overnight, early morning, day, evening, and weekend. You can even have four-day workweeks, three-day weekends – and with Anytime Shifts, you can work as little as four hours per week.
  4. Career advancement. We have made a pledge to upskill our employees and offer a variety of free training and development programs, and we also have tuition support options for select employee groups. See where your Amazon journey can take you.
  5. New skills. Depending on the role and location, you’ll learn: how to operate a garment press and high-capacity printer, a t-shirt folding machine, how to assist with the print production process, or how to receive and process customer returns.
  6. Free training. Depending on the role and location, we’ll teach you how to drive power industrial trucks (PIT) such as forklifts or a pallet driver, how the printing process works, and how to work with the latest Amazon technology – including robots.
  7. Team environment. Work on small or large teams that support each other.

Why You'll Love Amazon
Many of our jobs come with great benefits – including healthcare, parental leave, ways to save for the future, and opportunities for career advancement – all in a safe and inclusive environment that’s been ranked among the best workplaces in the world. Some offerings are dependent upon the role, work schedule, or location, and can include the following:
  1. Competitive wage paid weekly, with overtime for more than 40 hours
  2. Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
  3. Medical Advice Line
  4. Network of Support (health & well-being on and off the job)
  5. Adoption Assistance
  6. Maternity and Parental Leave
  7. 401(k) savings plan
  8. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  9. Holiday pay opportunities
  10. Employee discounts
  11. Basic life insurance
  12. AD&D insurance
  13. Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  14. On-the-job training and skills development
  15. Employee Assistance Program

Learn more about Amazon Benefits and Culture
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits#/
https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/culture#/

Requirements:
  1. Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation during the application and hiring process, including support for the New Hire Event, or need to initiate a request prior to starting your Day 1, please visit https://hiring.amazon.com/people-with-disabilities#/ or contact the Applicant-Candidate Accommodation Team (ACAT). You can reach us by phone at 888-435-9287, Monday through Friday, between 6 a.m. and 4 p.m. PT.

Amazon is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

job.title: Commercial Building Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Job Summary:
In this role you’ll be face-to-face ambassador of the company dealing directly with our clients.

You’ll assist the property supervisor in maintaining the physical aspects of the Indiana buildings by performing light repair and maintenance duties for both common areas of buildings and within tenant spaces; inspecting, investigating, or assessing conditions to be performed by third party vendors; inspecting, investing or assessing conditions after all work has been completed by such vendors.

This role requires a hands-on, highly skilled technician who can independently diagnose, repair, and maintain building systems while serving as the Owner Representative holding vendors accountable to Meritex standards, alongside the Senior Property Manager.
 The ideal candidate has deep experience in commercial or industrial facilities, strong troubleshooting skills across multiple trades, and the professionalism to interact with tenants, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
 

Responsibilities:

  • Support basic requests by tenants for repair, maintenance and projects, utilize vendors
  • Perform maintenance tasks as directed by supervisor.
  • Maintain good tenant relations – complete or escalate support for repairs as needed
  • Partner with vendors and contractors to check in to see if projects are on track.
  • Regularly inspect HVAC, fire/life safety equipment, document results and notify supervisor and vendor of any issues.
  • Keep supervisor informed as to status of work orders and work assignments.
  • Ensure all properties are free of trash and debris.
  • Replace lights and ceiling tiles and paint when needed.
  • Communicate all building and tenant issues to supervisor.
  • Be knowledgeable and continuously promote safe work practices. Complete all required training including OSHA trainings.
  • Other duties as assigned.
 

Education/Skills/Experience/Qualities:

  • 5+ years of hands-on maintenance experience in an industrial commercial setting
  • Knowledge of fire systems, managing vendors, bidding projects, HVAC
  • High school diploma or equivalent (requires some technical college or applicable certifications).
  • Dependability and a valid Indiana driver’s license, good driving record, ability to travel to multiple properties and comply with company policies with vehicle usage are required.
  • Ability to multitask, remain flexible and professional.
  • Maintain a positive team attitude and provide excellent customer service.
  • Mechanical aptitude, ability to read schematics/engineering
  • Requires walking and driving to properties, bending, twisting, lifting up to 20 lbs., and climbing fixed ladders to access roofs and extension ladders
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.

job.title: Warehouse Lead
job.description:
Job Summary 

We are seeking a dependable and motivated Floor Lead to support daily warehouse and distribution operations within an assigned department. This is a long-term temporary assignment starting at $24/hr with potential for conversion in the future, though conversions are not happening at this moment. This role is responsible for helping oversee workflow on the floor, supporting team performance, maintaining productivity and quality standards, and serving as a point of contact for associates and leadership throughout the shift. The ideal candidate will have at least 1 year of warehouse, production, fulfillment, or lead experience and be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. 

Responsibilities 

  • Support daily operations within an assigned department to help ensure workflow stays on track 

  • Help direct floor activity and provide day-to-day guidance to associates during the shift 

  • Monitor productivity, quality, and attendance within the work area 

  • Assist with training, coaching, and onboarding of new team members 

  • Communicate department priorities, updates, and operational needs to associates 

  • Partner with supervisors and operations leadership to address workflow issues and staffing needs 

  • Help identify and resolve production delays, quality concerns, and process gaps 

  • Ensure associates are following safety procedures, work instructions, and company policies 

  • Support coverage planning, task assignments, and labor balancing within the department 

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment 

  • Step in to assist with hands-on operational work as needed 

Qualifications 

  • Minimum 1 year of warehouse, production, fulfillment, or lead experience required 

  • Prior experience providing direction, coaching, or floor support to a team preferred 

  • Strong communication and organizational skills 

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities 

  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability 

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team 

  • Reliable attendance and strong work ethic 

  • Basic computer skills preferred 

  • Experience with warehouse systems, inventory processes, or department workflow is a plus 

Physical Requirements 

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods 

  • Frequent bending, reaching, lifting, and movement throughout the shift 

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation 

  • Ability to work in a warehouse or distribution environment with varying temperatures 

  • Ability to work safely around moving equipment, carts, freight, and other warehouse activity 

Schedule and Compensation 

Pay Rate: 24.00
Shift: Sun -Wed 7am - 5:30pm
